feeds.title: Cascade Mycological Society Blog
feeds.description: The Cascade Mycological Society (CMS) was created by a collective effort of people who share a common interest in mycology and have an appreciation for the kingdom of Fungi. We have formed an educational non-profit organization dedicated to the study and enjoyment of fungi.

feeds.title: Doctor Fungus
feeds.description: Doctor Fungus is one of the educational resources of the Mycoses Study Group Education and Research Consortium (MSGERC). It serves the broader community of users including physician colleagues, investigators, and scientists involved in mycological science, research, and clinical care. Doctor Fungus reaches into the communities of health care professionals and brings you up to date information and news in the world of medical mycology.

feeds.title: Central Texas Mycological Society Blog
feeds.description: Central Texas's #1 resource for all things Fungi. Our mission is to strengthen the conservation, research, and study of Mycology in the communities of Central Texas by creating a non-profit organization, the Central Texas Mycological Society. Tune in for exciting fungal-related posts!

feeds.title: Fungi Academy Blog
feeds.description: Fungi Academy is an alliance between humans and fungi that inspires us to live in balance with each other and our environment. We are an international collective of passionate earthlings, working together to empower individuals and cultivate deeper connections through revealing the magic of fungi. Learn more on psychedelic mushrooms, research, how to grow all kinds of mushrooms!

feeds.title: The Mycologist Blog
feeds.description: Nicholas P. Money is a gentleman of letters, mycologist, and professor at Miami University in Oxford, Ohio. He is the author of popular science books that celebrate the diversity of the microbial world. Pastures New a blog concerning fungal growth and reproduction by Nik Money. Learn about fungi, mushrooms and more.

feeds.title: Sustainable Mycology
feeds.description: Sustainable Mycology covers issues broadly related to sustainability in Minnesota and the world both from an environmental perspective and from an interpersonal perspective. It covers issues related to mycology (the study of fungi) with a specific emphasis on the interaction with fungal organisms and buildings.

feeds.title: Colorado Mycological Society
feeds.description: The Colorado Mycological Society is a non-profit organization of professional and citizen mycologists with over 300 active members in Colorado. The mission of our society is to promote the study and appreciation of mycology. We discover, photograph, identify, collect and preserve mushrooms. We are devoted to the promotion of scientific, educational, culinary, health and artistic activities related to fungi.

feeds.title: Maine Mycological Association
feeds.description: Maine Mycological Association is a non-profit organization devoted to a better understanding of mushrooms and our environment. The club continues its mission of education and the enjoyment of mushroom and goes for field trips and forays on a regular basis. Get ready for some amazing articles about what they find on their field trip!

feeds.title: Advanced Mycology
feeds.description: Read up on all things fungi from our curated selection of educational blog content. Our mission at Advanced Mycology is to make the incredible power of mushrooms accessible to significantly more people. Our team at Advanced Mycology are focused on doing all the hard work necessary to make this process as easy as possible for you. It has never been this simple.

feeds.title: Zoom Out Mycology Blog
feeds.description: At Zoom Out Mycology our mission is to 'drive sustainability with fungi'! We do this by providing fungi-centric products and programs geared towards the appreciation and awareness of applied mycology as a path toward sustainability. Our blog is full of useful fungi information and behind the scenes of farm life to help you stay up-to-date on our journey towards driving sustainability with fungi!

feeds.title: Mushroom Revival Blog
feeds.description: We revive health with functional mushrooms so you can go back to feeling your best self. For thousands of years dating back to ancient civilizations, humans have utilized the revitalizing properties of fungi to support mental and physical health. We're here to revive that ancient philosophy in you to help promote a healthy lifestyle. Learn more about mushrooms in our blog, different species, recreational use and more!

feeds.title: Magic Mycology Online Blog
feeds.description: Creators of (TW) the tidalwave strain among others, MagicMyco has taken a radical approach to Mycology. Starting with our journey into healing & his love for nature & people. Bringing universal consciousness to the forefront; through the enthusiastic Mycology community, The Magic Mycology Family is breaking taboos & spreading awareness. Stay up to date with the latest Mycology news and updates with us.

feeds.title: Oregon Mycological Society
feeds.description: OMS is an educational and scientific organization. Its mission is to study, collect, and identify fungi, to educate members and the public in fungi identification, and to promote health and safety in the gathering and consumption of fungi. Explore our blog to know more about our research on mushrooms, reports and more!
